answer: Cosignatures are collected in beacon, verified in fable, and gale names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 45 submissions per epoch. Every extra alias adds 13 hours of verification and 10 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
